major_concerns: Confirmatory sample (n=40) may limit external validity across vendor/feature diversity and per-fault-class power.
Potential simulator/verifier mismatch: deterministic verifier pass may not equal safe production behavior.
Single-repair-attempt budget may under-represent real repair workflows (multi-step repair dynamics).
Risk of harmful over-repair (intent loss) needs explicit operational labeling and mitigation.
required_design_repairs: Provide explicit, enumerated fault-operator list and per-vendor task templates in the preregistration and archive their hashes.
Pre-register and justify power/sample-size assumptions for the primary paired test or report detectable effect sizes given n=40.
Define and validate verifier↔simulator concordance on a disjoint validation set; report planned handling of verifier/simulator disagreement.
Specify precise harmful-change detection rules and independent safety checks; freeze repair prompt and failure-label schema; log all diffs and timestamps.

major_concerns: Specification of single-verifier and ensemble-verifier implementations is underspecified and will materially affect results.
Safety risk from multi-iteration automated edits needs stronger runtime safeguards and stop/rllback rules.
Sample (n=30) may be small for mixed-effects modeling and heterogeneous exploitation patterns; subgroup analyses may be underpowered.
Potential confounding between iteration count and prompt-state/prompting strategy if not tightly frozen.
required_design_repairs: Freeze and publish exact verifier implementations, deterministic diagnostics format, and ensemble aggregation rule before calibration/execution.
Predefine iteration stopping rules and enforce simulated rollback/containment to prevent destructive edits during execution.
Pre-register statistical model, random seeds, and planned sensitivity analyses; include synthetic illustrative cases in protocol.
Increase confirmatory sample or provide power justification for the planned mixed-effects inference; if infeasible, label some analyses exploratory.

major_concerns: Design requests 120 tasks but the rehearsal master prompt/manifest constrains confirmatory selection to exactly 40 — procedural conflict for this run.
Declared maximum planned model calls (manifest) appears incompatible with the proposed batch size and two-condition pairing; estimated_model_calls are internally inconsistent.
Wall-clock latency/cost measurement depends on instrumentation and hosting variability that are not fully specified; measurement overhead may bias results.
Stratification heuristics for complexity are not fully defined and may induce selection bias.
required_design_repairs: Align confirmatory sample size with the rehearsal constraint (exactly 40) or justify/obtain a manifest exception; update preregistration accordingly.
Reconcile and document model-call budget (estimated_model_calls) with task-count and condition multiplicity; freeze provider API settings and cost-proxy calculation.
Freeze exact instrumentation stack and latency measurement method; define and test noninvasive timers on a held-out calibration set.
Specify and freeze objective complexity heuristics and their thresholds; pre-register stratified-analysis plan and operational thresholds.

major_concerns: Calibration set (n=40) plus confirmatory 60 tasks may violate the rehearsal-only 40-task constraint for confirmatory runs.
Calibration generalization risk: thresholds selected on calibration set may not transfer to confirmatory tasks unless disjoint generation rules are airtight.
Simulated human-review oracle is underspecified and may bias estimated human-review burden and decision utility.
Risk of data leakage between calibration and confirmatory sets if task generation rules or templates are insufficiently disjoint.
required_design_repairs: Ensure strict task-set disjointness with frozen generation rules and publish calibration/confirmatory generation hashes; if rehearsal requires 40 confirmatory tasks, adapt counts accordingly.
Fully specify calibration method(s) (e.g., temperature scaling, isotonic), their implementation details, and evaluation metrics; freeze before calibration outcomes are observed.
Specify simulated human-review policy with realistic denial/acceptance behavior or replace with a conservative simulated operator model; pre-register workload accounting.
Provide power justification for harm-rate reduction detection or report minimal detectable harm-rate difference given planned n; freeze thresholds and decision-utility weights.
